Type: six-globe flush mount ceiling lamp
Use: general ceiling light; living room, dining room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, modern, contemporary
Materials: opal white glass globes, matte black metal frame
Colors: white, matte black
Shape: six round globes on short angled arms radiating from a central hub, short stem to round canopy, wide and low, close to the ceiling, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, graphic, playful
Goes with: white walls, black accents, walnut wood; mid-century or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern 6 Globe Flush Mount Metal Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture - 26 x 26 x 8 Inches, Matte Black
product.description: Bathe your interiors in light with this large, multifaceted pendant. The 6 matte-black metal branches hold up 6 spherical lights with white glass shades that emit warm light in all directions. 26"W x 26"D x 8"H Matte-black metal; white glass shade 6 glass shades Type A, bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
